battle.name: 伊斯蘭征服黎凡特
battle.brief: 公元六三四年七月，拉希敦軍在哈利德·伊本·瓦立德率領下，於安卡河畔艾因賈奈擊潰拜占庭與薩珊聯軍，打開敘利亞的門戶，隔年迫大馬士革開城。卡面的羅馬方陣盾是帝國前中期重步兵盾牆的象徵；到六三四年，羅馬式密集盾列早已退位給弓手、火槍手與鎧甲短劍兵，方陣盾在此役只是正在退場的舊戰法碑記。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 這場戰爭是哈里發國家成形之初，阿拉伯聯軍與晚期羅馬－拜占庭帝國在東地中海爭奪黎凡特的第一次大規模碰撞，交戰主體是三支力量。第一支是拉希敦的阿拉伯軍隊：由穆罕默德在麥地那統合起來的阿拉伯部落聯盟，編制以部族為骨架，戰時由哈里發直接任命統帥，再由哈利德·伊本·瓦立德、艾布·歐拜德·伊本·賈拉哈、阿姆魯·伊本·厄斯各領一翼，麥地那方面負責發動攻勢、決定停戰與分配戰利品，軍中同時有受薪的受難者營與大批志願從軍者，部族首領則以旗幟、旗鼓與宗教勸說維持部眾的戰意。第二支是拜占庭帝國的敘利亞戰區：帝國在安條克設有軍區指揮部，總督之下另有軍需官與野戰將領各領一部，步兵骨幹是徵召兵與傭兵混編的軍團，配以弓手、投射槍手、鎧甲短劍兵以及被編入軍列的象隊。第三支是薩珊波斯：六二八年希拉克略歸還薩珊失土後兩國恢復短暫和平，但阿拉伯人北進之際，波斯方面仍曾與拜占庭殘餘部隊在安卡河谷協同作戰。此外，拜占庭在南部敘利亞倚賴基督徒阿拉伯盟友加薩尼人充當前哨與嚮導；阿拉伯方面也有來自阿拉伯南部的部落站在拜占庭一線作戰。
countriesEn: This war was the first large-scale collision between the army of the emerging caliphate and the late Roman, that is Byzantine, Empire over the Levant, and it turned on three bodies of troops. The first was the Arab force of the Rashidun caliphate: an alliance of Arabian tribes united in Medina by Muhammad, organised on a tribal skeleton, with commanders appointed directly by the caliph, and the great columns led in the field by men such as Khalid ibn al-Walid, Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah and Amr ibn al-As, while Medina ordered the offensives and settled the truces and the division of the spoils; the army combined salaried mawali and mu'allaf troops with a large body of volunteers, and tribal leaders kept their men in the fight with banners, drums and religious exhortation. The second was the Syrian command of the Byzantine Empire: the empire kept its provincial headquarters at Antioch, with a military governor and, below him, a magister officiorum and other field commanders each leading a detachment; the infantry backbone was a mixture of conscripts and mercenaries, supported by archers, javelinmen, armoured swordsmen and an elephant corps drawn into the line of battle. The third was Sasanian Persia: after Heraclius had returned the territories taken in 602-628 the two powers had patched up a short peace, but when the Arabs drove north the Persians still fought alongside what remained of the Byzantine troops in the valley of the Banias. In addition, Byzantium relied on the Christian Arab allies of the Ghassanids as forward pickets and guides in the southern Levant, while on the Arab side there were tribes from southern Arabia who fought on the Byzantine line.
people: 帶頭的是穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜拉赫，麥地那的先知兼最高統帥，六三二年六月病逝前已完成阿拉伯半島大部分地區的統一，並以經典把出征定性為聖戰。他在世時只把最遠的戰線推到敘利亞南部，具體作戰交給他最信任的三人。艾布·歐拜德·伊本·賈拉哈是哈里發派駐敘利亞的總督，大馬士革開城後由他主持接管，其後病逝於敘利亞。哈利德·伊本·瓦立德約生於五二五年，出身塔伊家族，綽號「真主之劍」，是攻勢最兇猛的一線指揮，艾因賈奈與阿姆拉兩役都由他當面指揮，事後獲配敘利亞軍區。穆阿維葉·伊本·阿比·蘇菲揚在艾因賈奈以率領前鋒的希克爾營（Shiqr）嶄露頭角，六三五年受命接管大馬士革，是後來倭瑪亞王朝的奠基人。阿姆魯·伊本·厄斯在六三五年冬攻下大馬士革，後轉兵埃及。伊拉克方面由薩阿德·伊本·阿比·瓦卡斯收復希拉，北方戰線則由艾布·歐拜德與歐斯曼·伊本·厄夫奈爾接續。拜占庭方面可點名的是皇帝希拉克略本人，以及他派往敘利亞的兄弟與近臣，其中被阿拉伯史料提到名字的有軍需官瓦罕、馬爾提努斯與狄奧多西，另有安條克總督與各路野戰將領；具體歸屬在史料中分歧頗大。南線的加薩尼人首領賈巴拉·伊本·艾哈姆是拜占庭的盟友，據說在艾因賈奈陣亡。
peopleEn: At the head stands Muhammad ibn Abdallah, the prophet of Medina and supreme commander, who before his death in June 632 had united most of the Arabian peninsula and had made the campaigns into holy war by the text of the Quran. In his lifetime he pushed the furthest front only into the southern Levant and left the actual fighting to three men he trusted most. Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah was the governor the caliph sent to Syria; after the opening of Damascus he supervised the takeover, and he died of sickness in Syria later. Khalid ibn al-Walid, born about 525, of the Tay clan and nicknamed the Sword of God, was the fiercest of the field commanders; he led in person at Ajnadayn and at al-Arqa, and was afterwards allotted the command of the Syrian district. Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan first came to notice at Ajnadayn commanding his Shiqr band in the vanguard, was given charge of Damascus in 635, and was the founder of what would become the Umayyad dynasty. Amr ibn al-As took Damascus in the winter of 635 and afterwards turned his arms towards Egypt. On the Iraqi side Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas recovered al-Hira, while the northern line was carried on by Abu Ubayda and Uthman ibn Affan. On the Byzantine side the emperor Heraclius himself can be named, together with the brother and close officers he sent to Syria: the Arabic sources name the magister officiorum Vahan, Martinus and Theodosius, besides the governor of Antioch and the several field commanders; the exact attribution is a matter of some dispute in the sources. At the southern end of the line, Jabalah ibn al-Aiham, chief of the Ghassanids and an ally of Byzantium, is said to have been killed at Ajnadayn.
kits: 卡面是羅馬方陣盾（Scutum，約公元前100年），凸面長方木框蒙皮，羅馬重步兵的標準配備，也是帝國前中期盾牆戰法的物質核心：前列盾牌彼此咬合遮蔽全身，後列從上方把手伸過投矛，靠的是盾緣相接而不是盾體厚實。這件武器的履歷本身說明了一場變化——到公元四至六世紀，晚期羅馬與拜占庭的野戰步兵普遍改用橢圓盾與小型圓盾，長方大盾已退居守城、儀仗與輔助兵之列，密集方陣盾牆在野戰中不再被視為可倚賴的答案。所以六三四年的敘利亞戰場上，羅馬式盾列並不在主力之中：拜占庭一方的野戰骨幹是弓手與投射槍手、持短劍與匕首的鎧甲兵、少量重騎兵，以及被記載為倚重火油與火攻的攻城與火戰單位；阿拉伯方面的編年史在艾因賈奈記載聯軍以象群前列、以火油縱火破陣，並以地形與拒馬拖住阿拉伯騎兵。阿拉伯軍隊的裝備輕得多：部族兵多備複合反曲弓、標槍、長矛、短劍與彎刀，穿皮甲或鱗甲上衣，靠皮盾護身，極少重甲，不用象，沒有羅馬式的投射槍大隊與配重投石機行列，全軍靠騎兵與駱駝輸送，攻城則靠壕溝填土、雲梯、撞錘與火攻，更關鍵的是封鎖——切斷城堡的水源與鄉村的糧道，用時間與飢餓代替一次強攻。
kitsEn: The card shows the Roman scutum, a convex rectangular wooden frame covered with hide, the standard piece of the Roman heavy infantry and the material core of the shield-wall method of the early and middle Empire: the shields of the front rank locked edge to edge to cover the whole body, and those of the rank behind reached over them to throw their pila, relying on the meeting of shield edges rather than on the thickness of any shield. The career of this weapon itself records a change. By the fourth to sixth centuries the field infantry of the late Roman and Byzantine armies had generally taken up oval shields and small round ones, and the long rectangle had retreated to garrison duty, parade and auxiliary troops; the dense scutum wall was no longer treated in the field as an answer one could rely on. So the scutum was not among the main bodies on the Syrian battlefield of 634. The fighting core of the Byzantine side was archers and javelinmen, armoured swordsmen with spatha and dagger, a small number of heavy cavalry, and units that the sources show as relying on naphtha and fire attack; the Arabic chronicles of Ajnadayn describe the combined army putting elephants in front, breaking the line with naphtha, and holding the Arabs back with terrain and chevaux-de-frise. The Arab army was far lighter: tribal men carried composite recurve bows, javelins, lances, short swords and curved blades, wore leather or scale cuirasses and were covered by hide shields, were very seldom heavily armoured, used no elephants, and had none of the Roman close-order formations of pila or onagers. Transport was by horse and camel, siege by filling the ditch, ladders, rams and fire, and above all by blockade: cutting the water of the citadel and the grain of the countryside, and using time and hunger in place of a single assault.
tactics: 阿拉伯軍的作戰樣式可概括為封鎖、襲擊、攻城、再封鎖四步。封鎖靠騎兵小隊往返於城鎮與鄉村之間的道路，使守軍只能依賴城內存糧；襲擊利用部族騎兵在邊境游走、夜襲巡邏隊與運糧小隊，切斷敵軍的耳目；正式會戰採卡爾卡式的分離進攻，中央以旗號號令投入兵力，一半兵力正面接戰、另一半迂迴包抄，敵陣一旦被側翼插入便容易解體，這種全軍進攻在艾因賈奈與後來的葉爾穆克都有記載。拜占庭與波斯聯軍的部署仍偏向戰役式的正面對抗：選擇安卡河谷的窄地與緩坡列陣，步兵列縱深陣線，弓手與投射槍手置於陣地兩翼與後方，騎兵在側翼待機反衝，並以象群與火油製造混亂，希望把阿拉伯騎兵引入正面，消耗其銳氣再以整齊陣線收拾。攻城與守城的尺度也決定了勝負：大馬士革守軍靠城牆、投射器與城內水源抵抗近一年，最後以協商開城收場；耶路撒冷後來也靠城牆與地勢拖到六三八年。黎凡特一線的氣候同樣是變數，盛夏乾旱會同時削弱進攻方的士氣與供水，也讓守軍難以在城外維持遠程封鎖。
tacticsEn: The Arab way of war can be summarised in four steps: blockade, harassment, siege and renewed blockade. The blockade was kept up by squadrons of cavalry riding between the towns and the countryside, so that the defenders could rely on nothing but the grain inside the walls. Harassment used tribal cavalry to roam the frontier and to strike at night against patrols and supply columns, blinding the enemy. When the two sides actually met, the Arabs fought the separated attack of the karka: the centre engaged on a given order of the banners, half the force taking the front while the other half swung round the flank, and an enemy line once pierced on that flank tended to come apart; this kind of general attack is recorded at Ajnadayn and later at Yarmouk. The deployment of the Byzantine and Persian combined army still followed the older, set-piece model: taking up position in the narrow valley of the Banias on gentle slopes, the infantry drawn up in depth, archers and javelinmen placed on the wings and behind the line, cavalry waiting on the flank to counter-charge, and the elephants and naphtha used to throw the Arab cavalry into disorder in the hope of drawing them into the front where a neat line could grind them down. The scale of siege and defence also settled the outcome. The garrison of Damascus held out for close to a year behind its walls, its artillery and its water, and the city was finally entered by negotiated surrender; Jerusalem, later on, was held behind walls and broken ground until 638. The climate of the Levant line was a variable of its own: the dry heat of high summer drained the morale and the water of the attackers, and made it hard for the defenders to maintain a distant blockade outside the walls.
data: 時間點排得相當清楚：六三二年六月穆罕默德辭世，六三三年至六三四年阿拉伯軍先取伊拉克，六三四年三月或四月攻陷薩珊都城希拉，切斷美索不達米亞的門戶；六三四年七月三十日是艾因賈奈之戰的傳統日期，部分史家據季節線索改列八月，戰端由此在敘利亞南部拉開；六三四年九月阿拉伯軍合圍大馬士革，至六三五年九月開城，前後約一年；六三六年八月二十日葉爾穆克之役是整個戰役的決定點，敘利亞的野戰指揮權就此易手；六三七年至六三八年耶路撒冷淪陷；六四○年之後大馬士革、霍姆斯、貝卡與安條克相繼失守，六四一年敘利亞全境歸入哈里發國家。距離上，麥地那到大馬士革的商路逾一千二百公里，戰區沿安卡河谷南北拉開，前線部隊與後方基地之間要靠騎兵維持聯繫，供給線極薄，這也是阿拉伯軍不遠離既有綠洲與城鎮作戰的原因。傷亡與俘虜的數字只能當約數：阿拉伯方面的編年史記載艾因賈奈一役俘獲數千名敵軍官兵、繳獲大量武器、傢畜與金銀，但這類數字出自戰勝方的敍述並帶文學誇飾，不宜逐條當作精確統計。總兵力、陣亡人數與攻城時長，現存史料都沒有留下可核對的可靠數字。
dataEn: The chronology can be set out with fair precision. Muhammad died in June 632; between 633 and 634 the Arab armies took Iraq, and in March or April 634 they stormed al-Hira, the Sasanian capital, cutting the door of Mesopotamia. The traditional date of the battle of Ajnadayn is 30 July 634, though some historians move it to August on the strength of the seasonal evidence; from there the war was opened in the southern Levant. The Arab armies invested Damascus in September 634 and the city was handed over in September 635, after close on a year of resistance. The battle of Yarmouk on 20 August 636 was the decisive point of the whole campaign, and the command of the field in Syria changed hands there. Jerusalem fell between 637 and 638, and after 640 Damascus, Homs, Baalbek and Antioch went one after another, so that by 641 the whole of Syria was in the caliphate. As for distance, the road from Medina to Damascus runs to more than twelve hundred kilometres, while the theatre of war stretched north and south along the valley of the Banias, and contact between the forward columns and the base behind them had to be kept up by cavalry: the supply line was thin, and that is why the Arab armies did not stray far from the oases and towns already in hand. Figures for casualties and prisoners can only be treated as approximations. The Arabic chronicles record that Ajnadayn yielded several thousand enemy soldiers as prisoners together with much war material, livestock and treasure, but such numbers come from the account of the victors and are written with literary exaggeration, and they should not be read as exact statistics. For total strengths, for deaths in battle and for the length of the sieges, the surviving sources leave no reliable figures that can be checked.
cause: 打起來的原因分遠近兩層。遠層是四分之一的世紀裡哈里發國家的成形：六二二年穆罕默德在麥地那建立共同體，之後二十年的征伐把阿拉伯半島的部落聯盟捏成一個能持續徵兵、可供調度的政體，半島一旦統一，向北推進並終於撞上拜占庭邊界便是結構性的必然。近層是拜占庭自身的空虛：六二八年希拉克略與薩珊停戰，把大量邊軍與財政消耗在二十六年的消耗戰裡，戰後帝國在敘利亞只剩駐軍與稅收，兵源補充吃力，希臘火在波斯戰役中大量耗損而未能重建，邊防只能靠稅收與防禦工事維持。希拉克略本人在六三四年還施行阿拉伯化措施，限制阿拉伯人任職與穿戴，試圖以政策抵禦阿拉伯人，反而加深了摩擦。另一個常被提起的因素是商路：從麥地那經阿拉伯南部通往大馬士革與阿勒頗的舊商路，貿易隊與巡邏隊年年往返，麥地那的商人熟悉敘利亞的道路、渡口與城鎮，地理知識從來不是障礙。宗教與身份層面，阿拉伯部族記得羅馬－拜占庭統治下的稅負與邊境掠奪，也記得耶路撒冷與安條克在早期基督教傳統中的地位，於是戰爭自帶解放的說法。最後是哈里發繼承的危機：艾布·伯克爾六三三年遇刺後的權力交接，使敘利亞戰線需要一場勝利來證明新政權的正當性。
causeEn: The reasons lie at two distances. The far one is the forming of the caliphate across a quarter of a century: in 622 Muhammad founded the community at Medina, and the twenty years of campaigning that followed welded the tribal alliances of the Arabian peninsula into a polity that could levy men and move them, and once the peninsula was united, driving north until it met the Byzantine frontier was a structural necessity. The near one is the emptiness of Byzantium. The peace with Sasanian Persia in 628 closed twenty-six years of war that had consumed frontier garrisons and treasury alike; what was left afterwards in Syria was a garrison and a tax roll, the recruitment of replacements was hard, the naphtha had largely been used up in the Persian war and was not rebuilt, and the frontier could now only be held with money and fixed works. Heraclius himself in 634 put through measures to 'Arabise' the empire, restricting Arab officeholders and Arab dress in the hope of holding the Arabs at a distance, and this only deepened the friction. Another factor often named is the trade road: the old route from Medina through southern Arabia to Damascus and Aleppo was travelled every year by caravans and patrols, and the merchants of Medina knew the roads, fords and towns of Syria, so geography was never the obstacle. At the level of religion and identity, the tribes remembered the taxes and the border depredations of Roman and Byzantine rule, and also remembered Jerusalem and Antioch in the early Christian tradition, so the war carried a language of liberation with it. Last came the crisis of the caliphate's succession: after the assassination of Abu Bakr in 633, the handover of authority made it necessary for the Syrian front to win a battle that would prove the legitimacy of the new government.
impact: 對拜占庭而言，黎凡特的喪失是帝國史上的結構性轉折，遠不只等於失去幾座城池：敘利亞與埃及的稅收、兵源與糧食來源中斷，帝國重心東移向小亞細亞、安納托利亞與愛琴海，地中海的防衛圈被壓縮到君士坦丁堡周圍，帝國從橫跨三洲的強權變成以小亞細亞為核心的希臘語國家。此役之後官方敘述裡阿拉伯人取代波斯人成了首要敵人，政策從對波斯用兵轉為對阿拉伯人防守，六四二至六四五年拜占庭甚至趁阿拉伯內戰反攻美索不達米亞，一度攻入薩珊境內。這次教訓也被記在兵制上：晚期羅馬靠方陣盾牆作戰的時代已經過去，野戰縱隊的訓練、投射器的供應與兵員補充被重新檢視，帝國此後更多倚重標槍手、弓箭手、傭兵與專門編成的邊防部隊，而不是密集的重裝盾陣。對阿拉伯世界而言，這是哈里發國家的第一次大規模對外征服，也是正統哈里發時期最輝煌的成果之一，六五一年倭瑪亞王朝接替拉希敦後，大馬士革成為新王朝的都城，敘利亞的希臘語城市網與它們的商會被吸收進新的帝國結構，敘利亞總督府從此成為倭瑪亞權力的核心機關。長期看，黎凡特此後的歷史由基督教國家與穆斯林國家交替書寫：耶路撒冷的收歸、伍麥葉清真寺的興建，以及隨後數個世紀兩方在東地中海的反覆爭奪，都從這幾年開始鋪開。
impactEn: For Byzantium the loss of the Levant was a structural turning point in the history of the empire, and far more than the loss of a few cities: the revenue, the man-power and the food of Syria and Egypt were cut off, the centre of gravity shifted east towards Asia Minor, Anatolia and the Aegean, the defensive ring of the Mediterranean was pressed back to the neighbourhood of Constantinople, and the empire changed from a power spanning three continents into a Greek-speaking state centred on Asia Minor. In the official narrative the Arabs now replaced the Persians as the principal enemy, policy turned from campaigning against Persia to defence against the Arabs, and in 642-645 Byzantium even counter-attacked into Mesopotamia while the Arabs were busy with their own civil war, driving briefly into Sasanian territory. The lesson was also written into the military system: the age of fighting by the scutum wall was over, and the training of field columns, the supply of artillery and the replacement of troops were all reconsidered; from then on the empire relied far more on javelinmen, archers, mercenaries and purpose-built frontier units than on dense lines of heavy shields. For the Arab world this was the first large-scale outward conquest of the caliphate and one of the most glittering achievements of the rightly guided caliphs; when the Umayyads replaced the Rashiduns in 651, Damascus became the capital of the new dynasty, the Greek-speaking cities of Syria and their guilds were absorbed into the structure of the new empire, and the Syrian governorship became the central organ of Umayyad power. In the long run the history of the Levant was written alternately by Christian and Muslim states: the recovery of Jerusalem, the building of the Umayyad mosque, and the long alternation of the two powers in the eastern Mediterranean all begin to be laid out in these years.
result: 就戰役層面看，最終結局是阿拉伯方面的完全勝利，但過程並非一役而定。六三四年艾因賈奈，聯軍的正面與側翼都被突破，戰場上的旗幟、輜重與大批裝備成了繳獲；六三四年九月起大馬士革被圍近一年，守軍在城牆與城內存糧上苦撐，最後以談判開城，阿拉伯軍入城時維持秩序，六三五年艾布·歐拜德入主為總督。六三六年八月葉爾穆克是真正的斷點：拜占庭的野戰主力在此覆沒，敘利亞的城鎮此後不是被強攻攻破，而是被隔斷、談判與接管，耶路撒冷於六三八年投降，敘利亞的戰局在六四○至六四一年間基本結束。對卡面那件羅馬方陣盾而言，這場戰爭意味著一個時代的落幕：它所代表的盾緣咬住盾緣的羅馬防線觀念，在六三四年的黎凡特已經決定不了任何一場仗的勝負，真正改寫版圖的是部族騎兵、封鎖與攻城相結合的阿拉伯戰法。留下的問題同樣清楚：拜占庭的失地需要重奪，倭瑪亞王朝的廣闊疆域需要鞏固與內部整合，而阿拉伯帝國境內關於哈里發繼承與敘利亞行省治理的矛盾，也在征服完成後不久浮現，成為下一次內戰的伏線。
resultEn: At the level of the campaign the final outcome was a complete victory for the Arabs, but the process was not settled in a single battle. At Ajnadayn in 634 the front and the flank of the combined army were both broken, and the banners, baggage and mass of equipment on the field became Arab booty. From September 634 Damascus was invested for close on a year, the garrison holding out behind its walls on the grain in the city, and the city opened at last by negotiated surrender, the Arab army entering it in good order, with Abu Ubayda taking up the governorship in 635. Yarmouk in August 636 was the real break: the field army of Byzantium was destroyed there, and after that the cities of Syria were not stormed but cut off, negotiated with and taken over, Jerusalem surrendered in 638, and the Syrian war was essentially over between 640 and 641. For the Roman scutum on the card, this war meant the end of an age: the Roman idea of a defensive line in which shield edge gripped shield edge had already ceased to decide any battle in the Levant of 634, and what redrew the map was the Arab way of war, joining tribal cavalry with blockade and siege. The questions left over are just as clear: the lost provinces had to be retaken by Byzantium, the vast dominions of the Umayyads had to be consolidated and internally knitted together, and the strains inside the Arab empire over the succession of the caliphs and the governance of the Syrian province surfaced soon after the conquest was complete, forming the undercurrent of the next civil war.
